invariant: After Graphviz returns SVG, Java DotStringFactory.solve locates each cluster polygon, parses its serialized points, computes min/max from those decimal coordinates, and passes that reconstructed rectangle to Cluster.setPosition. Painted cluster geometry therefore uses the SVG polygon rectangle rather than Graphviz's higher-precision internal bounding box. Decimal reconstruction affects the painted origin, title centering, envelope, and canvas even when the resulting width happens to equal the internal width.
causal_divergence: The Rust layout crate already returns both internal cluster_positions and cluster_serialized_sizes reconstructed from two-decimal polygon coordinates. Class rendering uses only the internal box. In the held-out linked empty-package matrix, switching to the serialized rectangle and applying the common painted-envelope translation aligned the canvas, title, member entities, and links. A remaining cloud-path divergence was subsequently traced to CoordinateChange distance arithmetic rather than the reconstructed cluster width.
planned_change: Before class envelope normalization and paint, round each cluster origin to the SVG coordinate precision and replace its width/height with LayoutResult.cluster_serialized_sizes, matching DotStringFactory.solve. Preserve the internal graph extent for graph-level layout only. Exercise non-symbol and dimension-seeded symbol clusters around integer boundaries in both layout directions.
